meta.name: The China Syndrome
meta.description: While doing a series of reports on alternative energy sources, opportunistic reporter Kimberly Wells witnesses an accident at a nuclear power plant. Wells is determined to publicize the incident, but soon finds herself entangled in a sinister conspiracy to keep the full impact of the incident a secret.
meta.slogan: People who know the meaning of "The China Syndrome" are scared... Soon you will know.
